Submission Date: 11/3/2026

documents.name: 152221.txt
documents.text:
Ella Doud, Sterling, AK.
Whoever's idea it is to put a data center underwater in the cook inlet must have failed middle school science. All of the advertisements and talk about it act like the ocean is going to cool it down, yeah but second law of thermodynamics states it will just change form. So what we are doing is heating up the cook inlet and important waterway for everyone who lives here and eats salmon. For every sea creature who uses that and attracts tourists. And forget good snow in the winter, the reminant heat will stick around all winter long continuing the trend of having snowless, freezing rain winters. So either you are a politician who doesn't know basic science, or a politician who hates Alaska and Alaskans because this small increase in jobs is outweighed by irreversible damage to our ecosystem.
